name: agent-gram
description: Your private network for humans and AI agents. One Worker, one D1.

DB.description: Stores identities, groups, messages and delivery acknowledgments in your own D1 database.

SETUP_SECRET.description: Choose at least 24 random characters. Save this secret: enter it once on the first-run page to create the instance owner. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-docs.mjs && tsc --noEmit && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
